rows.en: Papa…
Then what about your mom?
Then, is she… your big sister?

I'm Rieko…

This boy doesn't remember anything, not even where he came from.

What?

But how? Why is Shadow after the two of you?
That's…

…!?

Mari!

Mari, why are you running away?

That karate-like move you used just now… who taught you that?

Don't ask!

Please, don't ask me…
Mari…
Jiro, what's wrong?
Ah, an android!

DARK's Destruction Squad!?

Jiro! You were going to help her?
Answer me, Jiro!!
You don't understand, Mitsuko! What it feels like to be an android reborn?
She asked me for help!
She's from DARK!
No matter who it is… if I can save someone without killing, I want to help.
There, that should do it…
Kikaider, why did you save me?
You're androids built to obey only evil people! You yourselves aren't to blame.

Kikaider, I… I want a Conscience Circuit too! I want to be like you!

When you get the blueprints, Kikaider, give me a Conscience Circuit too!
Come on, let's go! DARK will probably come after you.
Jiro, where are you going?
I'm going to hide her somewhere safe! Don't do anything rash. Just go back to the TDF! Got it?
Jiro!

Jiro's sure nice to that woman, huh? Even though she's from DARK's Destruction Squad…

I bet… androids can fall for each other, huh?
Oh, be quiet!
Sis…!

Jiro doesn't understand how I feel at all!

I don't care if DARK comes after me… I'll get those blueprints!

You can't, sis…

Jiro said you mustn't go near Taeko, didn't he!
Sis!

You'll be safe here…

Listen. Once I get the blueprints, I'll come back for you, I promise!

Until then, don't take a single step from here! Understand?
Yes… I'll be waiting!
See you, then…
Wait! Actually, there's something I want to tell you…
Something you want to tell me?
Yes… about the evil crime organization, Shadow…
Shadow?
So… you're saying this Shadow is a huge crime organization bent on world conquest?

I don't think Violet Sazae was lying…

It's clearly… a different organization from DARK! And they're far more terrifying.

Shadow's first objective is a plan to kill 10 million people!
A plan to kill 10 million people?

Shadow has a giant computer called Black Satan.

They're going to take the 10 million people Black Satan selects and…

Killing people chosen by a computer!

Then perfectly ordinary people could suddenly be targeted by Shadow one day, for no reason at all…
And it's one person in every ten…
Shadow, you monsters!

Good grief…

Destron, and now Shadow… More new organizations popping up. When will we ever get peace back? Honestly…

Oh…?
Jiro, it's terrible! Sis, sis has…
What happened to Mitsuko?
I tried really hard to stop her, but…
She went to Taeko's? After I told her so many times not to go…

Jiro!

………

Huh? The cactus… it's gone?

Hm?

Did that florist figure out their mistake?
Found you! Jiro!! How long do you plan to keep running and hiding?
Hakaider!? Wait! I don't want to fight you!
How pathetic, Kikaider!! Today, I destroy you! Make your peace!

Ugh… damn! I have to replace the blood in my brain with fresh blood! Kuh, after coming this far…

Kikaider! And Zero-One! Next time we meet… I'll have your lives, mark my words!
Brother Ichiro!!
Brother Ichiro!!
Jiro!!
Jiro!!
Something my father left with me?
Blueprints! For the Conscience Circuit!

Yes, I work alongside Dr. Araki as a member of the TDF science group.

Your father said he left the Conscience Circuit blueprints with you, Taeko…
Hmm? I don't have anything like that…
Then, anything at all… Is there anything your father gave you to keep, Taeko?
Hmm?

It's terribly important!

If I can just get those blueprints, one andro… I mean, one man will be saved.

………

Oh, I know! Maybe…
You remembered, Taeko?
Yes…
Tell me, what did he give you?
I'll be the one to hear that answer…
Kyaaaah!
Taeko!
If you don't want to die, tell me where the blueprints are!

uncertain: U04576: その人 = Rieko, the woman with Akira; 'she' used.
U04603: Masaru's teasing [ja] rendered 'androids can fall for each other'.
U04630: speaker is サブロー (Saburo, Hakaider's human form); next row names him Hakaider.
